context.description: Liveness comes from the status tags and the heartbeat
context.gherkin:
Scenario: UI3 Liveness comes from the status tags and the heartbeat
    Given a status file
    When the run lacks the ended tag and its heartbeat is at most 15 seconds old
    Then the view is live, and Tab, esc twice and the watch keys act on the run when the session owns its harness sessions
    And an older or absent heartbeat makes the view still, an ended run makes it ended, and no file makes it absent
    And the run keys leave a run alone when the view is not live or the session does not own it

  @phase4 @core @edge @ASSUMPTION:A2.a
